expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.lead: Daily and operating expenses — rent, utilities, supplies and everything else that keeps the business running.
expenses.no_breakdown: No expenses to break down yet.
expenses.category_help: Custom categories appear alongside the built-in ones and can have their own budget.
expenses.empty_text: Record rent, utilities, packaging and other running costs to see where money goes.
expenses.not_in_opex_help: Marketing, salaries and delivery costs come from their own modules, so these entries are not added to operating expenses again.
expenses.opex_note: Expenses filed under Marketing, Salaries (manual) or Delivery (manual) are kept for your records but are not counted in operating expenses again — campaigns, payroll and shipments already account for them.
